## The sequence

| # | Spoonful | What it says | The one ask | When |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Where we are after 14 October | Jonathan testified; cross went only to what he saw himself; the case rests on the class limit in the SPA; nothing is filed before 4 November except possibly the motion to resolve; King and De Leon are next. | A thirty-minute meeting this week; which neighbour goes first on 4 Nov; the 2026 notarial commission number. | Now |
| 1a | The neighbours: who goes first, and the notarial stamp | Which of King and De Leon takes 4 November; the stamp under the 23 January jurats reads "valid until 12/31/2025," so ask for the 2026 commission number, and if none covered that day, re-sign the same affidavits before a current notary and file them five days before each hearing. No supplemental affidavit for a neighbour. | The order for 4 Nov; the commission number or a re-signing day. | With 1, or right after; by 23 Oct |
| 1b | What Mrs. King's cases prove | No forum ever decided ownership (prosecutor, 28 Jul and 16 Sep 2020: "cannot pass upon the issue of ownership … file appropriate civil action"; recited by the Daet trial court and the Court of Appeals). The Bicol Post notices, annexed to King's Verified Answer in Civil Case 8563, were received by the Balane side's lawyer on 9 July 2021, 137 days before registration. Comes in on rebuttal against Princess and Jomil, or on King's re-direct if cross opens it. | His view on imputing the agent's or lawyer's notice to Gloria; re-direct or rebuttal only. | After 1a; by 28 Oct |
| 1c | Princess and Jomil, in their own words | Their Answer has both testifying to no notice of any dispute. Princess: blotter entry 2763, 19 May 2020, "May usapin pa yan." Jomil: 2020 counter-affidavit, "acting on instructions of the owner … Gloria Balane thru Nelly Juntilla"; the prosecutor's ownership ruling mailed to him 23 Sep 2020; ₱180,000 bail in 20-6030; his lawyer received the Bicol Post notices 9 Jul 2021. One-fact cross questions in January; certified records on rebuttal if denied. | Agree to request the prosecutor's file and the blotter now; cross in January or rebuttal only. | After 1b; by 28 Oct |
| 2 | Our summary judgment motion, on paper | The April motion has no ruling in the orders we hold. Ask whether the pre-trial order resolved it; if not, file a motion to resolve with the alternative prayer under Rule 35 §4 (as amended in 2020) that the court ascertain the facts without substantial controversy (Annex "A": our narrative, sixteen facts from the record). Draft attached. | His answer on the pre-trial order; his changes to the draft. | After 1 is answered; by 24 Oct |
| 3 | My mother testifies on rebuttal, by videoconference | Why rebuttal; what she will say; her draft affidavit attached for his review; the two questions only he can answer (the once-only leave; how she testifies from California). | His answer on the leave question and the videoconference route. | After 2 is answered; by 28 Oct |
| 4 | The receipts do not add up | Their own Exhibit 5: ₱602,750 receipted against a ₱250,000 price; ₱219,000 after the deed that says "in hand paid"; "Full payment" in February 2017. One table, no theory. | Agree to ask Salvador, on cross in January, for the duplicate leaves and the booklets. | After 3; by 31 Oct |
| 5 | Completing Exhibits E and H | Our filed copies are short pages; the certified complete copies are in hand; they are offered on 9 December. | Agree to mark the complete copies at the offer. | After 4; by 7 Nov |
| 6 | The neighbours on 4 and 11 November | The three-witness pack (one folder, one thing each, the lines to withdraw, the re-swearing if the commission question requires it); King's affidavit as filed; her 2021 pleading comes in later as a certified record; the two things she must not be led into (20-6030, the perjury case). | Confirm both dates; no supplemental affidavit for a neighbour. | Now, with 1; folder by 28 Oct |
| 7 | The 9 December offer | The exhibit list with one-line purposes; rest "subject to rebuttal"; ask for rebuttal dates after 10 March and for memoranda. | Approve the list and the three sentences for the record. | After 6; by 27 Nov |
| 8 | The lead argument in one page | Article 1898 and the class limit, with the exhibit page for each fact; what we do not argue. | Confirm this is the memorandum's spine. | After 7; December |
| 9 | Cross of Salvador | The checklist, his papers only: the 2005 down payment, "in hand paid" against February 2017, the serial numbers, the 1991 power, the Agcaoili channel. | Adopt or amend the questions. | In person, early January |
| 10 | Cross of Princess and Erwin | Renters since 1975; the 2006 survey receipt; the 2020 Toronto power; the rents (our damages figure); no permit on file. | Adopt or amend. | In person, January |
| 11 | What we hold for rebuttal | The records gathered quietly and what each answers; shown, not sent. | Decide the rebuttal order and the subpoenas. | In person, after the defense rests |

If a second lawyer joins as collaborating counsel, spoonfuls 1 to 3 go to Atty. Barandon alone and the rest go to both. If the consultant route is taken, the feed to Atty. Barandon does not change.
